detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed structure, possibly a shed, sits at the top edge of the outlined lot, north of the house, near the back fence.

signals.notes: The house has dark, multi-gabled roofing with some shading and possible light staining. Two vehicles are parked at the bottom of the driveway, and a large tree on the east side shades part of the yard. The pool in the neighboring lot to the southeast is outside the outline.
